rows.name: Rule/evidence relevance
evidencePredicates: Bind actual report/event and subject link; the selected rule must define the stated relevance role.
rows.disposition: Report/event basis is evidence, not a numeric operand. If the selected relevance use relies on measured content, the exact report-to-measurement link and measured role are required by that use.

rows.name: Rule applicability
evidencePredicates: Use the actual applicability conditions of R; match exact jurisdiction, time and context.
A negative applicability allegation requires an explicit exclusion or evaluated contrary condition, not missing evidence.
rows.disposition: Applicability conditions can depend on measured context. Required roles come from the pinned rule; absent measured conditions may not be silently skipped.

rows.name: Measured numeric criterion and alleged outcome
evidencePredicates: Criterion supplies operator, bound and unit semantics; no invented statutory threshold.
Resolve measurement/property/method/subject context and compare compatible units under the actual conversion profile; preserve original lexical value.
For an exact point x and threshold b, LE is true iff x<=b; alleged SATISFIED must agree.
rows.disposition: Existing measurement and operandPointer now have mandatory presence, exact tuple consistency and an evidence selector. New supplementary role fixture checks deletion even when citation table omits the role.

rows.name: Censored and uncertain criterion
evidencePredicates: Use the stated detection/quantification limit and bounds, with method domain constraints.
SATISFIED requires all admissible values satisfy the predicate; NOT_SATISFIED requires all fail; otherwise INDETERMINATE.
Do not turn statistical confidence into a hard interval without the method’s explicit rule.
rows.disposition: W05 adds exact source tuple, criterion, admissible bounds and independently pinned expectations. Uncertainty/censoring qualifiers are linked to exact source pointers and method use.

rows.name: Belgian product-authorisation identity allegation
evidencePredicates: Require exact product/permit mapping, one unambiguous candidate, matching BE jurisdiction, access/currentness basis and actual owner verification trace.
Required label/certificate evidence is conditional on the exact claim; active-substance-only or GTIN-only data cannot supply product authorisation.
An allegation does not issue a permit or promote a current-compliance output.
rows.disposition: Registry identity/currentness is separate owner verification; do not infer measurement from status.

rows.name: Label/use restriction allegation
evidencePredicates: Resolve the actual condition and exact product/label version; rate, target and window predicates are those of that condition.
Preserve planned versus as-applied product identity and any partial extent; no registry status alone proves correct use.
rows.disposition: HUMAN_REPORTED rate remains that posture. Required rateSource links the exact reported value; measured branch uses complete tuple. Label-bound thresholds and actual/planned material/basis/scope remain independent.

rows.name: Traceability claim-model allegation
evidencePredicates: Use exact governing basis and lineage/accounting evidence appropriate to that model.
DECLARED_OTHER needs the fully bound model definition; no implication of physical continuity from accounting.
rows.disposition: Mass-balance/accounting owner may require measured inputs. The row is a model allegation, not an unbound numeric total; preserve exact owner evaluation and require its operands under its pinned contract.

rows.name: Inspection/review determination allegation
evidencePredicates: Match actual decision finding, subject applicability and time; distinguish closure of a review from substantive compliance satisfaction.
A claimed in-force correction must bind the actual separately governed result; no result is created here.
rows.disposition: Report exact inspection decision; do not reinterpret its finding as a raw measurement.

rows.name: Sustainability constraint/metric allegation
evidencePredicates: Use the exact charter’s constraint class, operand/method and evidence requirement; no objective/AI score can substitute.
Retain claim-basis, freshness and disputed posture; pending submission never makes a sustainability output claim-ready.
rows.disposition: MODELLED baseline retains model basis. MEASURED branch requires tuple and qualification provenance; qualifier/branch deletion cannot bypass selected metric requirements.

rows.name: Evidence sufficiency allegation
evidencePredicates: The actual policy defines required kinds and status; bind admitted owner sufficiency evidence if alleging sufficiency.
No generic evidenceStatus string, source-provided Boolean or this assertion’s own text proves policy satisfaction.
rows.disposition: Policy sufficiency may depend on calibration/custody or other measurement qualification. Required-use owner determines fields; qualify exact records/pointers, never generic ACCEPTED_SUPPORT labels.

rows.name: RS holding registration/status allegation
evidencePredicates: Reconcile official transaction-date/year artifact and holding ID; live lookup alone cannot replace history.
ACTIVE, PASSIVE, SUBMITTED, RENEWED and UNKNOWN are distinct assertions, not interchangeable success labels.
Authentication does not establish submitter/delegate authority.
rows.disposition: Official registration/status source, not measured quantity.

rows.name: RS organic-certificate status allegation
evidencePredicates: Resolve certificate, subject relation, scope/date and issuer; both Ministry and accreditation scope/date must be evidenced where the profile requires them.
Suspended/withdrawn/expired/unknown states remain explicit. A validity date alone does not overcome adverse status.
This profile’s official evidence gaps and production hold remain; candidate bindings are not supplied live evidence.
rows.disposition: Certificate/issuer/scope/date/adverse status evidence remains exact; no measured quantity.

rows.name: RS certifier-authority-reference allegation
evidencePredicates: Require both source records, matching certifier identity, date and scope; different accreditation scope cannot prove this one.
Party is a typed issuer/reference role inside the allegation about the FARM, not an added authority subject or permission grant.
rows.disposition: Ministry/accreditation scope/date reports remain owner references.

rows.name: RS review/appeal status allegation
evidencePredicates: Require exact challenged act and official artifact; finality requires resolved review-window/status evidence.
An event of lodging an appeal is distinct from this allegation of its status and from the actual governance decision.
rows.disposition: Review/appeal state remains official artifact meaning.

rows.name: NL filed parcel/year/crop-history allegation
evidencePredicates: Use source-preserved filing and year-specific snapshots; public current parcel state cannot replace history.
Each history fact retains its own code revision and parcel lineage; no unstated cross-year code equivalence or area math.
rows.disposition: Source-preserved filing/history and year-code lineage; cannot insert measured area arithmetic without a defined owner role.

rows.name: NL rotation/exemption/deemed-compliance allegation
evidencePredicates: Bind the actual route definition, scope and owner evaluation; organic/in-conversion route requires actual profile-recognized proof.
Preserve the absent calculation semantics as an unresolved profile-evaluator dependency, not a generic boolean, 30-hectare carve-out or invented formula.

Candidate representation of a computed route records denominator numerator, exact rational/decimal operands, rounding rule, year-code crosswalk and lineage allocation as named, versioned evaluation inputs. These fields make the missing decisions explicit; they do not choose statutory rules.
rows.disposition: Any measured/calculated profile operand must be explicitly sourced in the pinned profile-owner evaluation. Do not manufacture missing NL calculation rules; current INDETERMINATE example remains unchanged.

rows.name: SI use-record completeness allegation
evidencePredicates: Check source-required/conditional fields and exact units/roles; resolve profile use type and conditional stage/start-time rules.
Profile advisory warning is not a compliance FAIL or accepted fact; external regulatory currentness and recordkeeping remain distinct.
rows.disposition: Record completeness checks presence/units/roles of the use record, distinct from proving measured actual quantities or lawful use.

crossCutting: C04 source/result and method-derived bound qualifiers
QUALIFIED sourceQuality on an atom that alleges a measured/uncertain basis
C06 source posture and C09 MEASURED vs MODELLED/ESTIMATED/DISPUTED
Required measured inputs inside C02/C07/C10/C16 selected owner evaluations
limit: Conditional owner roles are identified as required construction obligations, not claimed materialized or admitted here.
